mapper.sql: select a.address_id, a.courtyard_id, c.courtyard_name, a.address_name, a.detail_address, a.place_type, a.tenant_name, a.tenant_phone, a.status, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from ins_address a left join ins_courtyard c on a.courtyard_id = c.courtyard_id
mapper.select: select a.address_id, a.courtyard_id, c.courtyard_name, a.address_name, a.detail_address, a.place_type, coalesce(nullif(a.tenant_name,''), lg.tenant_name) as tenant_name, coalesce(nullif(a.tenant_phone,''), lg.tenant_phone) as tenant_phone, a.status, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from ins_address a left join ins_courtyard c on a.courtyard_id = c.courtyard_id left join ( select l.address_id, l.tenant_name, l.tenant_phone from ins_log l inner join ( select address_id, max(log_id) as log_id from ins_log where tenant_name is not null and tenant_name != '' and sub_type = #{subType} group by address_id ) lm on lm.log_id = l.log_id ) lg on lg.address_id = a.address_id where a.status = '0' and a.courtyard_id = #{query.courtyardId} and a.address_name like concat('%', #{query.addressName}, '%') order by a.address_name
mapper.insert: insert into ins_address(courtyard_id, address_name, detail_address, place_type, tenant_name, tenant_phone, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{courtyardId}, #{addressName}, #{detailAddress}, #{placeType}, #{tenantName}, #{tenantPhone}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
